features.name: a row of birds on a fence
features.desc-on-touch: Their outcast wings repeat a silhouette of telegraph poles at slightly different angles, providing semaphore. The shell tries them as six flags and returns one word, which it files beside a card dated 1923.

features.name: the passenger two seats ahead
features.desc-on-touch: The posture is familiar before they are looked at properly. They heave themselves up and adjust the strap of their wristwatch, bandage-like. They are holding a bag just like his. They leave. The train speeds up again.

features.name: a pale print on the window
succulents in worn terracotta pots
features.desc-on-touch: And flakes of risen concrete, in the backyards of the town beside the train.

file.name: Semaphore_Fence_6flags.txt
file.note: Six positions, read left to right. One word. Confidence: unverified.

exits.label: the platform that is not yours, where the passenger with the wristwatch got off
